title: First-Principles Thinking
hook: Half your business rules are borrowed. You never checked a single one.
statement: Strip it to what's true. Rebuild from there.
explainer: "That's how it's done" isn't a reason. The facts often hide a cheaper way.
sop: Pick one rule and trace its source.
Score Truth and Inherited Assumptions 1 to 10.
equation_example: Truth 8 ÷ Inherited Assumptions 6 = 1.3. Above 1, you're building on facts, not borrowed beliefs.
question: Name one business rule you never actually questioned.
closing_statement: Question the assumption before the conclusion.
